title: Argento - Sabbia Su Sabbia
direction: Use tiny granular clusters with broad spatial distribution and low force. Occasional denser moments can resemble grains briefly becoming rain, but keep the surface readable.

sections.name: granules: opening
sections.note: Frequent small granular note groups are distributed across the surface at restrained force. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
